title: Bound two 3-cycles with a dirty third register below by eleven (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

**Exact computer-assisted partial result in a formal model. No new κ.**

This follows up the open question of #5005, which proved two coordinate 3-cycles cost exactly 12 at `R = 2`. Here the target is `diag([c],[c],[e])` in `M_3(F2[GL_3(F2)])`: 168 paid factors, free scalar maps, and an arbitrary dirty third register restored exactly.

- **Result.** No realizing word has length ≤ 10, and one of length 12 exists. So the cost is 11 or 12, and a dirty register saves at most one call. **Length 11 is open.**
- **Engine.** `search.c` extends #5005's meet-in-the-middle to three registers.
  - Word reductions: cancellation, and an exact commutation normal form (9,912 commuting ordered pairs).
  - Symmetry: lexicographically least pair representatives under 36 target-fixing algebra automorphisms (827 of 28,056 pairs).
  - Fingerprint key matches are checked exactly with a stored radius-two ball.
- **Forward ball.** The counts are 169 / 22,051 / 2,705,791 / 325,910,698. The radius-two count matches the merged `gl3-order7-dirty-register-seed39ae`.
- **Parity cannot finish the case.** Calls `0, 28, 84, 0, 84` multiply to `I`, from the relation `C01·C02·C12 = C12·C01` on one register.

## Evidence

| Check | Where |
|---|---|
| Length ≤ 8 (depth 3 + 5), plus all controls | registered replay, 31 s locally |
| Length ≤ 9 (depth 4 + 5) | **local** receipt in `RESULT.json` |
| Length ≤ 10 (depth 4 + 6), 3.5·10¹¹ backward nodes, 53 min on 16 cores, 9 GB | **local** receipt in `RESULT.json` |

The default verifier checks:
- compilation with `-Wall -Wextra -Werror`;
- an exact binding of the C products to the merged Python formal model at `R = 3` (36 random words);
- an engine self-test and the state counts;
- positive controls with and without symmetry: `diag(c,e,e)`, `diag(C7,C7,e)` and two swaps, each with nothing at length ≤ 5 and length 6 found;
- the 12-call word and the odd relation;
- the main search: nothing at length ≤ 6 without symmetry, and nothing at length ≤ 8 with it.

`verify.py --full` reruns the local runs. The recorded runs are bound to `search.c` by hash. The binary that ran is byte-identical to a fresh compile.

In tamper tests, a changed `search.c` fails the hash binding, and a broken generator product fails the semantic binding.

## Scope

Card `bit-new-register-model`, scope changed (`TASK.json`). Only `n = 3`, `R = 3` is covered. Length 11, `R ≥ 4`, spectators, native operations, tariffs and κ are not settled. Selected frontier and frozen evidence are unchanged.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19148597
Base: `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.
